rubrics.title: Recorded code reuse and provider efficacy
rubrics.description: P019 uses existing registered instruments and outcome ledger. Preserve units, source windows and unknown populations.

criteria.title: Duplicate added lines per 1,000 eligible added lines
criteria.model: Count duplicate added non-generated lines / eligible added lines * 1,000. A pinned complete 28-day source census is required; empty/incomplete is unknown.
criteria.method: Resolve code-intel:reuse-redundancy-per-1000-lines; retain numerator, denominator, pinned source refs and window in the results ledger.
criteria.driftMarkers: Incomplete source census is zero, denominator units drift, or source/window refs are absent.
criteria.replication: Run testing:run {"files":["packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/reuse-measurement.integration.test.ts"],"harness":"papercusp"}. Inspect "measures exact units and keeps unresolved populations separate" and "registered instruments recompute exact-window raw populations with explicit ledger units": 10 duplicate added lines / 200 eligible added lines must yield 50 per 1,000, carried as ledger count quantity. Missing/mismatched raw window remains unknown. Retain exact source/test receipt and source refs. Then follow agent-insights/code-intel-reuse-measurement-runbook with the registered redundancy instrument.

criteria.title: Eligible work items searched before first write
criteria.model: Percentage of complete eligible work items with successful search before first write; incomplete work-item histories remain unknown and separate.
criteria.method: Resolve code-intel:reuse-search-before-write in the same 28-day harness window. Preserve numerator, eligible denominator, unknown count and exact evidence refs.
criteria.driftMarkers: Unknown histories count as failures or zero; post-write searches count as success; work items duplicate.
criteria.replication: Run testing:run {"files":["packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/reuse-measurement.integration.test.ts"],"harness":"papercusp"}. Inspect "counts a recorded search-before-write positive only through a unique exact assignment" and "registered instruments recompute exact-window raw populations with explicit ledger units". Seeded eligible searched-before-first-write item yields100%; preserve eligible/observed/unknown partitions and exact invocation/assignment refs. Missing or ambiguous assignment stays unknown. Retain canonical receipt/source identity and follow agent-insights/code-intel-reuse-measurement-runbook.

criteria.title: Resolved calls crossing file boundaries
criteria.model: Percentage of resolved static calls crossing files, with unresolved calls and incomplete syntax/source census separate.
criteria.method: Resolve code-intel:reuse-cross-file-call-ratio for the pinned 28-day source window; retain cross-file numerator, resolved denominator, unresolved count and source refs.
criteria.driftMarkers: Unresolved calls enter resolved denominator; incomplete census is complete; unknown is zero.
criteria.replication: Run testing:run {"files":["packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/reuse-measurement.integration.test.ts"],"harness":"papercusp"}. Inspect "derives exact added clone lines and a complete syntax-bound call census, including hidden locals and unresolved calls" and "registered instruments recompute exact-window raw populations with explicit ledger units". Seeded one resolved cross-file call yields100%; unresolved calls remain a separate population. Pin source/window and retain canonical receipt. Follow agent-insights/code-intel-reuse-measurement-runbook; static calls do not prove runtime execution.

criteria.title: Provider observations and reversible mature efficacy action
criteria.model: Disjoint per-provider issued, independent receipt when available, acted-on/not-acted-on/unknown and selector-specific grep over next20invocations/30minutes. Deterministic10% work-item/provider holdout;14days and100+100 observed maturity;28day horizon. Wilson95% no-improvement on both measures reversibly disables with persisted evidence. Unknown/immature never disables.
criteria.method: Resolve code-intel:reuse-provider-outcomes; inspect hash-verified exposure/activity refs, cohort maturity, evidence and reversal flag. Controlled fixtures in reuse-measurement.integration.test.ts prove mature-disable, keep and unknown.
criteria.driftMarkers: Issued means delivered, absent activity is negative, selectors merge, immature data disables, or disable lacks evidence/reversal.
criteria.replication: Run testing:run {"files":["packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/reuse-measurement.integration.test.ts"],"harness":"papercusp"}. Inspect "partitions acted-on, not-acted-on and unknown without counting issuance as delivery", hash-cohort/window cases, "disables only a mature ineffective population and retains a mature beneficial population", "refuses disabling on immature, unknown, stale or foreign populations", and persisted flag-writer case. Missing independent receipts/activity completeness remain unknown; only mature complete controlled evidence may disable via existing flag writer. Retain evidence and reversal flag. Follow agent-insights/code-intel-reuse-measurement-runbook.

rubrics.title: SQL tool proposal quality and repair adoption

criteria.title: Proposal review quality
criteria.model: Every proposal in the current 14-day workspace cohort has an accepted review; pending remains unknown and declined is a measured failure.
criteria.method: Execute the scoped SQL probe over each candidate edition latest canonical ledger rows. Zero or more than 1000 members and incomplete evidence are unknown; any measured failure fails the cohort.
criteria.driftMarkers: A candidate failure is masked by another pass, missing evidence is graded healthy, or the scope/window/denominator is absent.
criteria.replication: Run npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/sql-tool-candidate-feedback.integration.test.ts; includes realPG scoped cohort failure, missing, repeat, and grading controls.

probe.sql:
WITH latest AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (file_path) file_path,status,execution_details->'check'->>'criterionKey' AS key
      FROM harness_shared.test_runs
      WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND source='local' AND framework='rubric-check'
        AND finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND finished_at <= NOW()
        AND file_path ~ '^rubric-check/sql-tool-opportunity-feedback/[a-f0-9]{64}:(proposal-quality|repair-outcome):0$'
      ORDER BY file_path,finished_at DESC,id DESC
    ), cohort AS (
      SELECT status FROM latest WHERE key LIKE '%:proposal-quality'
    ) SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 OR COUNT(*)>1000 THEN NULL
      WHEN BOOL_OR(status='fail') THEN 0
      WHEN BOOL_OR(status<>'pass') THEN NULL ELSE 1 END AS value FROM cohort

criteria.title: Measured repair adoption
criteria.model: Every accepted proposal in the current 14-day workspace cohort has complete normalized repair evidence and passes coverage and tool adoption.
criteria.method: Execute the scoped SQL probe over each candidate edition latest canonical ledger rows. Zero or more than 1000 members and incomplete evidence are unknown; any measured failure fails the cohort.
criteria.driftMarkers: A candidate failure is masked by another pass, missing evidence is graded healthy, or the scope/window/denominator is absent.
criteria.replication: Run npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/sql-tool-candidate-feedback.integration.test.ts; includes realPG scoped cohort failure, missing, repeat, and grading controls.

probe.sql:
WITH latest AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (file_path) file_path,status,execution_details->'check'->>'criterionKey' AS key
      FROM harness_shared.test_runs
      WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND source='local' AND framework='rubric-check'
        AND finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND finished_at <= NOW()
        AND file_path ~ '^rubric-check/sql-tool-opportunity-feedback/[a-f0-9]{64}:(proposal-quality|repair-outcome):0$'
      ORDER BY file_path,finished_at DESC,id DESC
    ), cohort AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(r.status,'error') AS status FROM latest q
      LEFT JOIN latest r ON r.key=replace(q.key,':proposal-quality',':repair-outcome')
      WHERE q.key LIKE '%:proposal-quality' AND q.status='pass'
    ) SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 OR COUNT(*)>1000 THEN NULL
      WHEN BOOL_OR(status='fail') THEN 0
      WHEN BOOL_OR(status<>'pass') THEN NULL ELSE 1 END AS value FROM cohort
